name: Doki Doki Pretty League - Lovely Star
original_name: ドキドキプリティリーグ Lovely Star
source:
In the game the player takes again the role of a baseball coach that is going to coach the Kasumigaura high school female baseball team during a one year period of time. The task is to decide the training (battling, fielding, etc.) that each player is going to make each week and see their progress.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/D/SLPS-02673.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
在游戏中，玩家再次扮演棒球教练的角色，将在一年的时间内执教霞浦高中女子棒球队。任务是决定每个球员每周要进行的训练（战斗、守备等）并查看他们的进展。

[来自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/D/SLPS-02673.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
